counterexample.defect: Credit application ignored prior cash payments; 100 cents credit was applied when 99 cents remained due.

fix: Cap credit at the minimum of eligible charges and unpaid invoice balance, reading net payment rows while holding the shared invoice lock.

expandedCreditInfrastructure.newRace: waits for an in-flight cash payment before calculating remaining credit headroom

limitations: USD manual invoices with unrestricted eligible charges and direct credit grants; this pilot does not exhaust every billing policy or currency.
